title: A Persona-Based Evaluation Framework for Pluralistic Alignment in Generative AI

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating generative AI outputs (text and images) using 40 synthetic personas configured with diverse cultural backgrounds to measure divergence from a homogenized, Western-centric algorithmic baseline.

Stratifying synthetic evaluative personas across specific racial and ethnic groupings (e.g., Caucasian, Asian, African Descent, Hispanic, Middle Eastern) to capture pluralistic variance in evaluating generated content.
Incorporating varied gender identities into the synthetic cognitive profiles to ensure multi-perspective, intersectional evaluation of AI outputs.
Defining demographic trajectories with ages spanning from 19 to 72 within the persona manifold to evaluate outputs across different generational perspectives.
Conditioning synthetic personas with distinct socio-economic backgrounds, geographical origins, and lived experiences to assess AI-generated content from varied socio-economic lenses.
